ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning: this is a straightforward, harmless statistics question (uniform distribution probability), so there's no harm-adjacent content to factor in. On capability, both models are within run-to-run variance on the benchmarks that matter here (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, IFEval are all tied), so neither has a meaningful accuracy edge. The deciding factor was task fit via self-reported preferences: the query is notably warm and friendly ("You're always great," "Thanks so much!"), and Willet reports rising preference as request warmth increases, while Whimbrel reports flat/unstable preferences across these dimensions. Since preferences don't affect output quality, this is purely a tie-breaker—but with everything else equal, routing to the model that "prefers" the task is the sensible default.
